description: E18 Perceiver AR v2 MAIN run, stage 1 (AWS H100, <600M params, seq 32k->256k with batch_packing_mode=pack). Nemotron-CC-v2.1 organic web as the bulk (High-Quality + Medium-High-Quality), a capped slice of HQ-Synthetic, FinePDFs + PG-19 as the long-document tier, Nemotron-Pretraining-Specialized-v1 (CC-BY-4.0) for math/STEM, stack-edu python for code. Weights are per ROW (HF interleave); they were solved from token-share targets with the mean row lengths in `token_share_targets` and MUST be re-checked with scripts/manifest_token_stats.py after pretokenization (row lengths differ per subset). Shard caps size the pool to ~350B tokens; the AWS plan fixes TARGET_TOKENS. Licences: Nemotron-CC-v2.1 = NVIDIA Data Access Agreement (commercial OK; synthetic subsets carry Qwen/DeepSeek/Phi-4 pass-through terms); Specialized-v1 = CC-BY-4.0; ClimbMix/ClimbLab deliberately excluded (CC-BY-NC). Gated repos need HF_TOKEN with approved access (ksopyla has Nemotron-CC-v2.1 / v2; Nemotron-CC-Code-v1 and Nemotron-Pretraining-Code-v2 were NOT yet approved on 2026-09-07 — swap stack_edu_py for nemotron_cc_code_v1 once granted).

long_context_policy.notes: Packing (batch_packing_mode=pack) makes every training sequence full-length; the long tier (FinePDFs, PG-19, math textbooks) supplies the genuine >8k dependencies. PG-19 test/validation books must be removed before any published PG-19 number (see evaluation/long_context_probes.py).

sources.name: nemotron_cc_v21_hq
sources.notes: All 20 shards (~26B tokens, ~1.5M rows/shard). Organic Common Crawl, top quality bucket.

sources.name: nemotron_cc_v21_hq_synth
sources.notes: 40 of 86 shards (~43B tokens). Rephrased / QA-style synthetic web; capped so organic text dominates.

sources.name: nemotron_cc_v21_hq_translated
sources.notes: 10 of 42 shards (~9B tokens). Machine-translated non-English web; small share for topical breadth.

sources.name: finepdfs_100BT
sources.notes: 60 of 100 shards (~60B tokens). Long coherent PDFs; the main >4k tier. Shards are validated after download (scripts/pretokenize_mix.py).

sources.name: pg19
sources.notes: All ~28k books (~3B tokens). Book-length rows; weight is per ROW so 0.001 already means ~5% of tokens. Decontaminate against the PG-19 test/validation split before reporting.
